'''Purple amaranth''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|purple amaranth flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|purple amaranth beer]]. Its leaves are edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] purple amaranths for their ''striking color''.
